summary: Federal Communications Commission urged to preserve and strengthen E-Rate program for schools and libraries. The comment urges the FCC to protect the E-Rate program, reject proposals to sunset or eliminate it, and work with schools to strengthen and modernize the program rather than reduce its role in public education. The comment emphasizes the importance of E-Rate for providing reliable, affordable connectivity to students and schools, regardless of their location or financial circumstances. The comment highlights the cost savings and educational benefits of maintaining the program.

claims.requested_action: Reject proposals to sunset or eliminate E-Rate program
claims.argument: Rejecting sunset proposals would prevent unnecessary cost reductions
claims.evidence_quote: I therefore respectfully urge the Commission to: Reject any proposal to sunset or eliminate the E-Rate program; Reject proposals that would unnecessarily narrow E-Rate eligibility or restrict support based solely on geography or other criteria that would leave students without adequate support; Preserve support for the connectivity and internal network infrastructure schools need to provide reliable educational access; and Work with schools and other stakeholders to strengthen and modernize E-Rate rather than reduce its role in public education.
